name: How do I choose a contractor for a room addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a contractor for a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for a room addition, look for licensed, insured, and experienced professionals specializing in additions. Ask for references from past clients and review their portfolios. Ensure they have a strong understanding of local building codes in areas like Berkeley or Albany. Get detailed, written estimates from multiple contractors, comparing not just price but also scope of work, timeline, and communication style. Clear communication and a good working relationship are vital for a successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed, insured, and experienced contractor by checking references, reviewing portfolios, and comparing detailed estimates.
